care_team_notes: Review mobility early and repeatedly with OT and physiotherapy as weakness changes; include falls history, fatigue, transfers, home layout and carer safety.
description: MND-specific guidance on day-to-day changes, mobility, falls, fatigue, pain/discomfort, positioning, personal care and support from OT/physio teams.
name: Daily life with MND

care_team_notes: Plan ahead because MND can progress quickly; get OT assessment before ordering home modifications, hoists, wheelchairs, beds or pressure-care equipment.
description: MND-specific information about assistive technology, power wheelchairs, hoists, ramps, cushions, mattresses and home modifications.
name: Equipment and home modifications

care_team_notes: Ask OT/physio to review falls, near-falls, transfers, foot drop, footwear, fatigue, bathroom access, night toileting and whether a personal alarm or call system is needed.
description: Guidance about falls risk, home safety, walking aids, footwear, alarms, emergency response and when medical assessment is needed after a fall.
name: Falls prevention and response

care_team_notes: Train family and paid carers in the agreed transfer method; reassess before transfers become unsafe or require force.
description: Practical area covering chair-to-bed movement, toilet/shower transfers, hoists, slings, standing lifters, assisted repositioning and carer injury prevention.
name: Transfers and carer safety

care_team_notes: Review skin risk when mobility decreases, sitting time increases, transfers are harder, nutrition changes or the person cannot reposition independently.
description: Australian guidance on pressure injury risk, skin checks, repositioning, support surfaces and when to seek clinical review.
name: Pressure care and repositioning

care_team_notes: Funding evidence should include diagnosis/progression, functional impact, risk, urgency, trials, quotes, home assessment and clinical recommendations.
description: Funding pathways for wheelchairs, hoists, beds, pressure care, bathroom aids, ramps, home modifications and daily-living equipment.
name: Funding mobility and daily living supports
publisher: NDIS / My Aged Care / State equipment schemes
